name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
shortDescription: A routine blood test that evaluates red cells, white cells and platelets and helps assess overall health, anemia and infection.

name: Hemoglobin (Hb)
shortDescription: Measures hemoglobin levels to help assess oxygen-carrying capacity and screen for anemia.

name: ESR
shortDescription: Measures the rate at which red blood cells settle and can support evaluation of inflammation.

name: Platelet Count
shortDescription: Measures the number of platelets in blood and helps assess bleeding and clotting-related conditions.

name: Peripheral Smear
shortDescription: Examines blood cells under a microscope to assess their size, shape and appearance.

name: Blood Group & Rh Factor
shortDescription: Determines ABO blood group and Rh factor for medical records, transfusion and pregnancy-related care.

name: Reticulocyte Count
shortDescription: Measures young red blood cells and helps evaluate bone marrow response and anemia.

name: Fasting Blood Sugar
shortDescription: Measures blood glucose after fasting and is commonly used to screen for and monitor diabetes.

name: Post Prandial Blood Sugar
shortDescription: Measures blood glucose after a meal to help assess glucose control.

name: Random Blood Sugar
shortDescription: Measures blood glucose at any time and is useful for quick glucose assessment.

name: HbA1c
shortDescription: Reflects average blood glucose levels over approximately the previous 2–3 months.

name: Insulin Fasting
shortDescription: Measures fasting insulin levels and may be used with glucose testing to assess insulin regulation.

name: C-Peptide
shortDescription: Helps assess the body's own insulin production.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
shortDescription: A panel of tests that evaluates liver enzymes, proteins and bilirubin to assess liver function.

name: Bilirubin Total
shortDescription: Measures total bilirubin, a marker used in evaluating liver and bile-related conditions.

name: Bilirubin Direct
shortDescription: Measures conjugated bilirubin and supports evaluation of liver and bile duct function.

name: SGOT / AST
shortDescription: Measures AST, an enzyme used with other tests to assess liver and tissue health.

name: SGPT / ALT
shortDescription: Measures ALT, an enzyme commonly used to assess liver cell injury.

name: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
shortDescription: Measures an enzyme associated with the liver, bile ducts and bones.

name: Gamma GT (GGT)
shortDescription: Measures GGT, an enzyme that can support evaluation of liver and bile duct conditions.

name: Total Protein
shortDescription: Measures the total amount of major proteins in blood and supports nutritional and liver assessment.

name: Albumin
shortDescription: Measures albumin, a major blood protein produced by the liver.

name: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
shortDescription: A panel that evaluates kidney-related markers including creatinine, urea and electrolytes.

name: Creatinine
shortDescription: Measures blood creatinine, a key marker used to assess kidney filtration.

name: Blood Urea
shortDescription: Measures urea in blood and supports assessment of kidney function and hydration status.

name: Uric Acid
shortDescription: Measures uric acid levels and is commonly used when evaluating gout and uric acid balance.

name: Electrolytes
shortDescription: Measures important minerals such as sodium and potassium that support fluid and nerve-muscle balance.

name: Sodium
shortDescription: Measures sodium levels, an important electrolyte for fluid and nerve-muscle balance.

name: Potassium
shortDescription: Measures potassium levels, an electrolyte important for heart and muscle function.

name: Calcium
shortDescription: Measures blood calcium levels, supporting evaluation of bone and mineral metabolism.

name: Phosphorus
shortDescription: Measures blood phosphorus levels and supports assessment of bone and mineral balance.

name: Lipid Profile
shortDescription: Measures cholesterol and triglycerides to help assess cardiovascular risk.

name: Total Cholesterol
shortDescription: Measures total cholesterol in blood as part of cardiovascular risk assessment.

name: HDL Cholesterol
shortDescription: Measures HDL cholesterol, commonly known as protective cholesterol.

name: LDL Cholesterol
shortDescription: Measures LDL cholesterol, an important marker used in cardiovascular risk assessment.

name: Triglycerides
shortDescription: Measures triglycerides, a type of blood fat associated with cardiovascular and metabolic health.

name: Thyroid Profile (T3 T4 TSH)
shortDescription: A thyroid panel measuring T3, T4 and TSH to support evaluation of thyroid function.

name: TSH
shortDescription: Measures thyroid-stimulating hormone and is commonly used as an initial thyroid function test.

name: Free T3
shortDescription: Measures the unbound form of T3 hormone and supports thyroid function assessment.

name: Free T4
shortDescription: Measures the unbound form of thyroxine and supports thyroid function assessment.

name: Vitamin B12
shortDescription: Measures vitamin B12 levels, supporting evaluation of nutritional status and deficiency.

name: Vitamin D Total
shortDescription: Measures vitamin D status and supports evaluation of vitamin D deficiency.

name: Folate
shortDescription: Measures folate levels and supports evaluation of nutritional status and certain types of anemia.

name: Iron
shortDescription: Measures circulating iron and supports assessment of iron status.

name: Ferritin
shortDescription: Measures ferritin, a major marker of stored iron in the body.

name: TIBC
shortDescription: Measures the blood's iron-binding capacity and helps assess iron status.

name: Iron Studies
shortDescription: A group of tests used to assess iron availability and iron stores.

name: CRP
shortDescription: Measures C-reactive protein, a marker that can help assess inflammation in the body.

name: hs-CRP
shortDescription: Measures low levels of C-reactive protein and may be used as part of cardiovascular risk assessment.

name: Dengue NS1 Antigen
shortDescription: Detects dengue NS1 antigen and can support early laboratory evaluation of dengue infection.

name: Dengue IgG IgM
shortDescription: Detects dengue IgG and IgM antibodies to support evaluation of dengue exposure or infection.

name: Malaria Antigen
shortDescription: Detects malaria antigens in blood and supports laboratory evaluation of malaria infection.

name: Typhoid IgM
shortDescription: Detects IgM antibodies associated with typhoid infection and supports clinical evaluation.

name: Widal Test
shortDescription: Serological test that may support evaluation of suspected enteric fever alongside clinical findings.

name: HIV 1 & 2 Antibody/Antigen
shortDescription: Screens for HIV-1 and HIV-2 infection using antigen and antibody markers.

name: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)
shortDescription: Screens for hepatitis B surface antigen, an important marker of hepatitis B infection.

name: Anti-HCV
shortDescription: Screens for antibodies against hepatitis C virus.

name: VDRL
shortDescription: A screening test for antibodies associated with syphilis; reactive results require appropriate follow-up testing.

name: Hepatitis A IgM
shortDescription: Detects IgM antibodies associated with recent hepatitis A infection.

name: Hepatitis E IgM
shortDescription: Detects IgM antibodies associated with recent hepatitis E infection.

name: Urine Routine & Microscopy
shortDescription: Examines urine for physical, chemical and microscopic findings to support urinary and general health assessment.

name: Urine Culture
shortDescription: Identifies bacteria in urine and helps guide evaluation of urinary tract infection.
preparation: Clean-catch sample; collect before antibiotics when advised

name: Urine Protein
shortDescription: Checks for protein in urine and supports assessment of kidney-related abnormalities.

name: Urine Glucose
shortDescription: Checks for glucose in urine and can support assessment of abnormal glucose handling.

name: Urine Microalbumin
shortDescription: Measures small amounts of albumin in urine and can help detect early kidney changes.

name: Stool Routine Examination
shortDescription: Examines stool for common physical and microscopic findings to support digestive health assessment.

name: Stool Occult Blood
shortDescription: Detects hidden blood in stool and may support evaluation of gastrointestinal bleeding.

name: Stool Culture
shortDescription: Tests stool for certain disease-causing bacteria and supports evaluation of gastrointestinal infection.

name: Amylase
shortDescription: Measures amylase, an enzyme associated with the pancreas and salivary glands.

name: Lipase
shortDescription: Measures lipase, an enzyme commonly used in assessment of pancreatic conditions.

name: LDH
shortDescription: Measures lactate dehydrogenase, an enzyme released from many tissues when cells are damaged.

name: CK Total
shortDescription: Measures creatine kinase, an enzyme found in muscle and other tissues.

name: CK-MB
shortDescription: Measures the CK-MB fraction and may support assessment of heart muscle injury alongside clinical evaluation.

name: Troponin I
shortDescription: Measures cardiac troponin I, a marker used in evaluation of suspected heart muscle injury.

name: PSA Total
shortDescription: Measures prostate-specific antigen and is commonly used in prostate health evaluation.
preparation: Avoid ejaculation and strenuous cycling before test when advised

name: Free PSA
shortDescription: Measures free PSA and may be used with total PSA for further prostate health assessment.

name: Total Testosterone
shortDescription: Measures total testosterone and supports evaluation of male hormonal status.

name: Free Testosterone
shortDescription: Measures the biologically available fraction of testosterone.

name: LH
shortDescription: Measures luteinizing hormone and supports evaluation of reproductive and hormonal function.

name: FSH
shortDescription: Measures follicle-stimulating hormone and supports evaluation of reproductive and hormonal function.

name: Prolactin
shortDescription: Measures prolactin, a hormone involved in reproductive and endocrine function.
preparation: Morning sample preferred; rest before collection

name: Estradiol
shortDescription: Measures estradiol, an important estrogen hormone used in reproductive and hormonal assessment.

name: Progesterone
shortDescription: Measures progesterone and supports evaluation of ovulation and reproductive hormone status.
preparation: Test timing may depend on menstrual cycle

name: Cortisol Morning
shortDescription: Measures morning cortisol to support evaluation of adrenal hormone function.

name: CA-125
shortDescription: Measures CA-125, a tumor marker that may be used with other clinical information in ovarian health evaluation.

name: CEA
shortDescription: Measures carcinoembryonic antigen, a tumor marker used alongside clinical evaluation and other tests.

name: AFP
shortDescription: Measures alpha-fetoprotein, a marker used in selected liver and reproductive health evaluations.

name: CA 19-9
shortDescription: Measures CA 19-9, a tumor marker interpreted with symptoms, imaging and other clinical findings.

name: Allergy Screening Panel
shortDescription: A screening panel that assesses selected allergy-related markers and can support evaluation of allergic conditions.

name: ANA
shortDescription: Screens for antinuclear antibodies and may support evaluation of certain autoimmune conditions.

name: ASO Titre
shortDescription: Measures antibodies associated with recent streptococcal infection and is interpreted with clinical findings.

name: D-Dimer
shortDescription: Measures D-dimer, a marker used in selected clinical situations when evaluating abnormal clot formation or breakdown.

name: Blood Culture
shortDescription: Checks blood for bacterial or fungal growth and helps identify bloodstream infections.
